patch.description: Partial update. The nickname can be changed at any time (it must stay unique); an empty string clears optional text fields. A photo is uploaded straight to storage (own folder, RLS) and then attached with `avatarPath`; `null` removes it. Role and e-mail cannot be changed here.

valid.description: Matches the nickname rules (3–20 letters, digits, _).

available.description: Valid and not taken by anyone.

put.summary: Save the caller's predictions for matches of one tour
put.description: New predictions are inserted, existing ones changed. Allowed while the season is active, the match is not played or cancelled and the tour deadline has not passed (the database enforces it): otherwise 409 predictions.closed. A match outside the tour is 422. Scores are whole numbers 0–99.

patch.summary: Grant or revoke the admin role
patch.description: The last admin cannot be demoted (409 admin.last_admin). Every user can read who the admins are; only an admin can change it.

patch.summary: Edit a participant's profile as an admin
patch.description: Same fields and rules as PATCH /me (nickname uniqueness is 409 profile.nickname_taken). The photo can only be removed (avatarPath null). Only the changed field names are logged.
The same fields as PATCH /me; `avatarPath` may only be null (remove the photo).

get.summary: Preview the import of a tour's schedule and results from the league source
get.description: Reads one round from TheSportsDB (D-090) and says, per match, what an import would do: create, update, same, or blocked with the reason. Nothing is written. A source failure is 502 fixtures.unavailable.

parameters.name: round
parameters.description: Round of the league; the number of the tour by default.

schema.description: Round of the league; the number of the tour by default.

homeName.description: Name in our catalogue; null when not found.

post.summary: Apply the confirmed rows of the import preview
post.description: The source is read again and the named rows are recomputed; only create/update rows are applied, the rest are reported as skipped. Results are graded by the database as for a manual entry.

keys.description: Keys of the preview rows the admin confirmed.

post.description: Both clubs must be in the season roster. `kickoffAt` is a UTC instant.

patch.summary: Change a match or enter its result
patch.description: status=finished needs both scores (final score incl. extra time, without penalties); any other status clears them. Points are graded by the database.

delete.description: A match with predictions is refused with 409 admin.in_use: cancel it instead.

post.summary: Start signing in through the Telegram bot
post.description: Creates a one-time attempt (valid 10 minutes). The visitor opens the bot link, presses Start and picks the two-digit `code` in the bot; poll `/auth/telegram/status` until it says `confirmed`, then go to `/auth/telegram?token=…`.

token.description: Secret of this sign-in attempt; keep it in the browser, never log it.

code.description: Two-digit number to show; the visitor picks it in the bot.

appUrl.description: tg:// link that opens the bot in the Telegram app.

webUrl.description: https://t.me link for devices without the app.

get.summary: Progress of a Telegram sign-in attempt

status.description: confirmed: continue to /auth/telegram?token=… to open the session.

get.summary: Latest regular videos of the YouTube channel (no Shorts), newest first
get.description: Read from the channel's RSS and cached for an hour. If YouTube fails, the last cached list is returned; without one the endpoint answers 503 videos.unavailable.
